question:
In the following question, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a87775381c97d3fc47c8d8c17b633d50bb8aec1ac380c6d50a52ed6a1852b5e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Inner figure become outer figure for the next figure in each figure.

New inner figure is added in each next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af4ac382c6d32b4d6db5cbaeea1428e84e7c0dab919c0f2cf5961c15575f2cca.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
